33:   // Detect rising edge of req (each new request)
34:   val reqRise = req && !RegNext(req, false.B)
35: 
36:   // 1. Bounded liveness: every request rising edge must be followed by an ack within 15 cycles.
37:   //    The FSM takes idle→starting(1)→working(1)→...→done(≤9)→ack(1), so 15 is a safe bound.
38:   astRelaxedLiveness(reqRise, ack, 15, "req_rise_leads_to_ack")
39: 
40:   // 2. Safety: ack must be a single-cycle pulse — it cannot persist for two consecutive cycles
41:   //    (the done state transitions to idle immediately).
42:   fvAssert(!(ack && RegNext(ack, false.B)), "ack_is_single_cycle")
43: 
44:   // 3. Safety: ack must be preceded by a pending request that has not yet been acknowledged.
45:   //    Track outstanding requests with a pending flag.
46:   val pendingReq = RegInit(false.B)
47:   when(req)   { pendingReq := true.B }
48:   when(ack)   { pendingReq := false.B }
49:   assertImplies(ack, pendingReq, "ack_only_when_req_pending")
50: 
51:   // 4. Safety: req and ack must never be simultaneously high.
52:   //    The FSM requires at least 3 cycles from req (idle→starting→working→done), so
53:   //    ack can never coincide with the request that triggered it.
54:   fvAssert(!(req && ack), "req_ack_not_concurrent")
